pr_title: [Core][BugFix][Test] Fix sequence parallelism for both MoE and dense model
source_quote: Confirm why it is written this way.

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha b9c124f 体现修改

rule.description: 不要在代码中添加基于魔法值（如 `eps == 1e-6`）的特殊分支而不加说明。这类特判路径使行为依赖于隐含的参数值，难以维护和测试。应统一调用路径，确保所有输入走相同逻辑。
checkpoints: 检查是否存在基于硬编码数值（如 `1e-6`、`0.001`）的条件分支
确认该分支是否有注释说明原因，若无则应删除或补充说明
评估特判分支是否引入了与主路径不一致的行为（如省略参数 vs 显式传参）

diff.unified:
--- a/vllm_ascend/compilation/passes/sequence_parallelism.py
+++ b/vllm_ascend/compilation/passes/sequence_parallelism.py
@@ -10,8 +10,6 @@
 
     def __call__(self, input, residual, weight):
         """Call the norm op with the same arity Dynamo emits for its defaults."""
-        if self.eps == 1e-6:  # 特判 eps==1e-6 时省略 eps 参数
-            return torch.ops._C_ascend.npu_add_rms_norm_bias(input, residual, weight)
         return torch.ops._C_ascend.npu_add_rms_norm_bias(input, residual, weight, None, self.eps)
